acknowledge.text: You're noticing a lot right now. That kind of clear attention is worth enjoying.

options.title: Notice one thing fully
options.text: Pick one thing around you and give it all your attention for a few breaths.
options.why: Clear attention can make an ordinary moment feel fuller.

options.title: Write what you see
options.text: What are you noticing today that you usually miss?
options.why: Writing down what you notice can help you see it again later.
options.prompt: What I'm noticing today that I usually miss:

acknowledge.text: You're in the zone. That's a good place to be.

options.title: Protect the focus
options.text: Silence one notification and give the thing in front of you a little longer.
options.why: Focus often lasts longer when it has fewer interruptions.

options.title: A short stretch break
options.text: When you come up for air, roll your shoulders and look into the distance.
options.why: A brief pause can help focus stay comfortable rather than tense.

acknowledge.text: Something's making the day lighter. Good.

options.title: Pass it on
options.text: Send someone a cheerful message, just because.
options.why: Good moods often grow a little when they are shared.

options.title: Note the cause
options.text: What lifted your mood today?
options.why: Knowing what cheers you can make it easier to find again.

acknowledge.text: Something made you laugh, or nearly. Hold on to that.

options.title: Share the joke
options.text: Tell someone what made you smile.
options.why: Laughing with someone is often even better than laughing alone.

options.title: Keep it for later
options.text: Jot down what amused you, for a day that needs it.
options.why: A funny moment, written down, can cheer you up again later.

acknowledge.text: A playful mood. Those are worth making room for.

options.title: Play a little
options.text: Doodle, hum, try something silly for a moment. No purpose needed.
options.why: Play for its own sake can be a real kind of rest.

options.title: Invite someone in
options.text: Suggest something light to do with someone you like.
options.why: Playfulness tends to be catching, in a good way.

acknowledge.text: Something feels possible. That's a lovely feeling to have.

options.title: Name the hope
options.text: What are you hoping for, and what is one small step towards it?
options.why: Writing a hope down can make it feel more real.
options.prompt: What I'm hoping for, and one small step:

options.title: A note for a harder day
options.text: Write to yourself about this hope, for a day when it feels far away.
options.why: Your own hopeful words can be easier to believe later.

acknowledge.text: You feel sure of yourself today. Enjoy it.

options.title: Use it
options.text: Do the thing you've been unsure about while you feel this way.
options.why: Confidence can make a first step easier.

options.title: For a day of doubt
options.text: Write to yourself for a day when you doubt yourself: what do you know now?
options.why: On a doubtful day, your own words from a confident one can help.

acknowledge.text: Your mind feels sharp. That can be a great feeling.

options.title: Tackle something tricky
options.text: Pick a puzzle you have been putting off and give it a go.
options.why: A sharp mind often enjoys a real challenge.

options.title: Capture your ideas
options.text: Write down the thoughts that are flowing, before they go.
options.why: Good thinking is easier to keep when it is written down.

acknowledge.text: You feel like you matter here. You do.

options.title: What made it feel that way?
options.text: What happened that made you feel important today?
options.why: Knowing where this feeling comes from can help you find it again.
options.prompt: What made me feel I matter today:

options.title: Pass it on
options.text: Tell someone else why they matter to you.
options.why: Feeling valued often grows when we help others feel it too.

acknowledge.text: You're ready to go. A good moment to begin something.

options.title: Start the smallest part
options.text: Pick one piece of what you want to do and start it now, even briefly.
options.why: Starting while motivation is here often carries you further.

options.title: Plan the next step
options.text: Write the very next step down, so future you can pick it up.
options.why: A clear next step can keep momentum going on a slower day.

acknowledge.text: Ideas are coming. That is a good kind of energy.

options.title: Make something
options.text: Sketch, write, build, cook: give the ideas somewhere to go.
options.why: Creative energy tends to feel best when it is used.

options.title: Catch the ideas
options.text: List the ideas, even half-formed ones.
options.why: Ideas often come back more easily once they are written down.

acknowledge.text: Something has delighted you. Let yourself enjoy it.

options.title: Savour it
options.text: Close your eyes for a moment and replay what delighted you.
options.why: Pausing on a good moment can help it stay with you a little longer.

options.title: Tell someone
options.text: Share the good news or the lovely moment with someone.
options.why: Telling someone often makes a good moment last longer.

acknowledge.text: You're proud of something. You're allowed to be.

options.title: Write down what you did
options.text: What are you proud of, and what did it take?
options.why: Naming what it took can help you remember you can do it again.
options.prompt: What I'm proud of, and what it took:

options.title: A letter for a doubting day
options.text: Write to yourself for a day when you doubt yourself.
options.why: Your own proud moment can be good company on a doubtful day.

acknowledge.text: You feel brave. That can open doors.

options.title: One bold, small step
options.text: Do one thing slightly outside your comfort zone today.
options.why: Small brave steps can make the next one easier.

options.title: Check it fits
options.text: Is the bold thing also a kind thing, for you and for others? If so, go.
options.why: Brave and kind together tend to feel good afterwards too.

acknowledge.text: Something has caught your curiosity. Follow it a little.

options.title: Dig in
options.text: Give the thing that fascinates you some time today.
options.why: Following curiosity can be both restful and energising.

options.title: Write the questions
options.text: What do you want to find out?
options.why: Questions written down can turn into a lovely rabbit hole later.
options.prompt: What I want to find out:

acknowledge.text: Lots going on, in a good way.

options.title: Catch your breath
options.text: Take three slow breaths between things.
options.why: A short pause can help lots of input stay enjoyable.

options.title: Pick one thing
options.text: Choose the most interesting thing and give it your attention.
options.why: Picking one thread can help a busy mind feel settled and still engaged.

acknowledge.text: Plenty of energy today. Lovely.

options.title: Move with it
options.text: A brisk walk, a dance, a few stretches: let the energy out.
options.why: Using energy in your body often feels good and can help you settle later.

options.title: Get something done
options.text: Pick a task that needs energy and do it now.
options.why: Energy put to use tends to leave a good feeling behind.

acknowledge.text: You feel alive and bright. Enjoy it.

options.title: Notice it in your body
options.text: Where do you feel this brightness? Notice it for a moment.
options.why: Knowing how a good feeling feels can help you recognise it again.

options.title: Save the feeling
options.text: Write a line about today for a duller day.
options.why: A few words from a bright day can be a comfort later.

acknowledge.text: Something good is coming, or already here.

options.title: Share the excitement
options.text: Tell someone what you are looking forward to.
options.why: Excitement shared often feels even bigger.

options.title: Settle a little if you like
options.text: If it is keeping you buzzing, three slow breaths can help.
options.why: A few slow breaths can help excitement feel good rather than restless.

acknowledge.text: You feel like going big today.

options.title: Choose where it goes
options.text: Go big on something you'll be glad about tomorrow too.
options.why: A pause before a big choice can help it stay a happy one.

options.title: A generous gesture
options.text: Do something generous for someone, big or small.
options.why: Generosity often leaves a warm feeling on both sides.
